description: Positive regression corpus for the deterministic Intent Canvas grammar. Every case was machine-verified against the parser at authoring time; the offline eval (pnpm eval:grammar) re-verifies on every CI run so grammar patches prove they broke nothing. Cases with scoped=true are first rewritten by normalizeScopedVoiceUtterance (the hold-to-edit path).

knownGaps.description: A short modifier may be an inferred label, while spoken up/down are placement directions rather than accidental labels.
Supported word-form counts through twenty must not leak into inferred labels.
Bare custom is not a registered node alias, so it must enter semantic fallback instead of inventing a node type.
The definite article is accepted as singular create syntax.
Named or unsupported placement anchors require semantic grounding and must never become accidental labels.

knownGaps.description: Scoped create commands pass through preprocessing unchanged and use the normal create grammar.
A conjunction inside a possible source label is structurally ambiguous and must use semantic fallback rather than mis-splitting endpoints.

knownGaps.description: A to-and branching form remains semantic-only; the deterministic parser must not flatten it into one edge.

knownGaps.description: Multiple possible endpoint separators are ambiguous and must use semantic fallback.

knownGaps.description: A scoped connection binds the held object as deictic this before parsing.
The natural deictic phrase this one must resolve as this, never as a literal board label.

knownGaps.description: Link is a supported semantic alias but intentionally not a deterministic verb, so it must invoke semantic fallback.
Trailing courtesy is not part of a connector label.

knownGaps.description: Endpoint articles are stripped while display case and normalized lookup labels remain correct.

knownGaps.description: Undo last change is an unambiguous, supported undo command.
Unscoped destructive pronouns require semantic clarification; scoped pronouns bind to selection, while a non-destructive named rename remains supported.
A rename with multiple possible to separators is ambiguous and must use semantic fallback rather than guessing the target.

scenarios.text: rename Send to Queue to Publish

knownGaps.description: The optional to filler and spoken up alias produce a move above.
Scoped movement accepts above and below alongside up and down.
Horizontal alignment produces a shared row on the y axis.
Grid layout remains valid without the optional in a filler.
Selection words are valid new labels after a selected target has been established.
A comma before trailing courtesy is stripped before placement parsing and must never become a node label.
Right, now, and like are accepted as leading spoken fillers without consuming a placement direction.
Unscoped it remains non-deterministic, while scoped preprocessing strips fillers and supplies the held selection target.
The lower word-count boundary beyond ten is executed through the spoken parser path.
Wake-addressed and scoped cases execute through their production preprocessing paths, not a scratch parser.
